question: What is the meaning of bill of materials in relation to unique product identifiers, general information?
description: The bill of materials (BOM) is a list of the raw materials, sub-assemblies, intermediate assemblies, sub-components, components, and the quantities of each needed to manufacture an end product. In the context of unique product identifiers and general information, the BOM can serve as a unique identifier for a product, providing a clear and reconstructable origin of the dataset. This is particularly important for materials passports, as it allows for the tracing of materials and products throughout their life cycle and beyond. The BOM can also be used to collect and link data from different sources, facilitating the implementation of take-back systems and other circular solutions.
